summary: The three deletions jobs A and B were denied by the clamp, plus one wrong sentence

tests.command:
bash tests/test-epic-goal-stop.sh
bash -c 'bash tests/test-epic-goal-stop.sh && bash tests/test-native-points.sh'
bash -c '[ -f scripts/compound-v-epic-watch.py ] || exit 0; /usr/bin/python3 scripts/compound-v-epic-watch.py --selftest'
bash -c '[ -f scripts/compound-v-headless-shim.py ] || exit 0; /usr/bin/python3 scripts/compound-v-headless-shim.py --selftest'
bash -c '[ -f tests/test-native-points.sh ] || exit 0; bash tests/test-native-points.sh'
bash -c 'for t in tests/*.sh; do bash "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done; echo all-tests-ok'
failures: bash -c 'for t in tests/*.sh; do bash "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done; echo all-tests-ok'
